name: syb-widgets
description: SurfYogaBeer website widgets (Google reviews, WhatsApp button, Instagram grid). Replaces Elfsight, plus the SYB leader pages.

scripts.build: python3 scripts/build-reviews.py && cp src/*.js dist/ && for f in syb-reviews syb-whatsapp syb-instagram; do npx -y terser@5 dist/$f.js -c -m -o dist/$f.min.js; done && mkdir -p dist/leader && cp src/syb-leader.js src/syb-leader.css dist/leader/ && npx -y terser@5 dist/leader/syb-leader.js -c -m -o dist/leader/syb-leader.min.js && npx -y clean-css-cli@5 -o dist/leader/syb-leader.min.css dist/leader/syb-leader.css
